tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral gyi thug chog gtum drag 'od 'bar bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma he ru kā ya/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /dbang drag phrin las kun 'dus drag shul can/ /skyes bu dbang mdangs rig lha 'khor bcas la/ /btud de gong gi ru mtshon rnam gzhag bshad/ /ces mchod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ srung ma'i dbang po 'di'i lo rgyus rgyud dang brgyud pa'i rnam thar thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rjes gnang man ngag sogs ni be'u bum dang / gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar lags pas/ de dag bla slob dam ldan rnams kyi brgyud pa'i bka' srol bzhin thob nas/ bstan srung chen po 'di nyid sgrub tshul la du ma yod pa las/ 'dir ru mtshon gyi rnam gzhag thug khang bca' tshul dang bcas pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po ni/ tsandan dmar po'am/ seng lding dmar po'am/ gzhan yang shug lcang dkar po la srog shing ji ltar rigs pa bzos/ de dug khrag mtshal rgya skyegs sogs kyis kha dog dmar por bsgyur ba'i rtser mi rta khyi sogs srog chags du ma bsad pa'i gri lcags kyi thug so sgrub pa po'i khru gang gi tshad ral gri so gnyis pa'i rnam pa 'og gi sne gnyis la a long nyis brtsegs gsum re 'dogs pa'i bug par btag gsham sbubs can nang lcam dral gyi srog sngags 'dod gsol bcas dkris la chu dang sgrog zer gyis mi gnod par bya/ srog shing rtsa bar mdung rting spyi 'gre bskyon thug so'i 'og tu g.yag 'bras can kham pa'am/ yang na g.yag dkar 'bras can gyi rnga ma btsag sogs kyis dmar por bsgyur ba'i zhel phod bya/ de'i nang du sku rten ro ras la lcam dral 'khor bcas sam/ lcam dral gyi sku bris/ gsung rten srog 'khor gsang sngags/ thugs rten gri lcags me long / yon tan rten bum rdzas nyer lnga/ phrin las rten bse byang mig dgu/ lcags byang mig dgu/

dug shing byang bur srog sngags 'dod gsol bcas/ dgra bgegs kyi mgo lag rkang pa 'gron bu'i lan tshar/ dril bu g.yer kha/ stag ras/ gzig ras/ gos dar sna tshogs kyi lce le/ gos dmar gyi 'phan rkang gsum pa sogs btag rnga phod/ de'i phyi nas gos dar ras sogs kyi lce le kha dog sna tshogs pas mdzes par bya/ gong gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rten rnams 'dogs/ gong du rab gnas dang bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de lta bu'i thug de thag rgyang ngam/ mañdzi sogs la brten nas bsgreng ba'i gnas su yi dam gyi lha dang / gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi bris sku la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten mtshan nyid tshang zhing rab gnas dang ldan pa ci 'byor man ngag ltar bshams/ de dag gi mdun du stegs bu'i steng du zangs gzhong la sogs rin po che'i snod bzang por khrag chang gis sbrus la/ yab kyi gtor ma khru gang las mi che zhing mtho gang las mi chung ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon du lha mo dang las mkhan gyi gtor ma gru gsum de las cung zad chung ba re re/ de gsum gyi mthar de las chung ba'i bshos bu gru gsum rtse dang zur shin tu rno ba brgyad dang / de'i phyi rol du nyer gcig rnams gri thogs brgyad dang ro bshan gyi tshogs la bsham pa'i mtha' mtheb skyu bcad kham phyir bstan pa'am/ bsdu na dbus kyi gru gsum gyi mthar mtheb skyu chung ba brgya dang nyer gcig gis bskor la/ de'i steng gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtheb skyu che ba re re bzhag kyang rung de thams cad kyang sha khrag dang snying sna tshogs/ khyad par ra skyes kyi sha khrag gis brgyan pa la/ snyug rgod kyi mda' la dur bya'am 'ug pa'i sgros brgyan pa/ gri lcags kyi mde'u can gyi mgul du dar dmar nag la gser gyis lcam sring gi srog sngags bris la/ sku tsakli za 'og gi 'phan dang bcas pa btsugs/

de dag gi mdun du khrag chang gi gser skyems/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sha chen dang gu gul/ ra tshil sogs kyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ btsan bshos dkar dmar/ thod rnga rkang gling sogs rol mo'i bye brag du ma/ bag zan las ra skyes kyi gzugs brnyan 'bri mog gis dmar por byugs/ gzhan yang sha chen/ ra sha la phug sgog btsong / 'bras chen/ 'khur ba sogs bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / btung ba'i bye brag ci 'byor pa bshams par bya'o/ /gsol kha'i chas sha sna khur ba sogs zas sna dang khrag chang / sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ rnga rol/ dung rkang gling g.yab dar/ sha chen tshil chen/ ra tshil sogs bdug pa dang gzhan yang sngar nas bsgrubs zin pa'i rnam 'joms sogs kyi bum chu bum pa kha rgyan/ mgul chings/ me long / sku phyi/ sbyong chas/ mtheb skyu til chang yungs dkar gu gul sogs 'og tu gang dgos ma tshang ba med par bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rta mgrin yang gsang sogs bla med khro bo'i rigs kyi bdag bskyed yi dam chos srung spyi dang / khyad par 'di nyid kyi gtor bsngo bskang ba nas bzung rdor glu rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ thug gi mdun zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed ma'i sbyong chas rnams bshams/ sbyong ba/ de gnyis kyi 'don cha phyag rgya rnams spyi ltar byas mthar/ deng 'dir gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan sgrub par byed pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i sogs rgyun bzhin/ drag po'i sbyong ba'i khro bo spyan 'dren bden bdar rgyun bzhin la/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir sogs gong bzhin dang /

mjug rgyun bzhin tshar gsum/ rten khrus/ thugs la phar phyin drug khrus/ gang la ser sna/ slar khrus sku phyi rgyun bzhin/ de nas/ mchod gtor rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i ngo bo 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ rnam pa dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag gi mchod gtor/ dar sna tshogs kyi gur dang / rgyu rlon gyi phreng ba dang / don snying gi tshal pas brgyan pa/ stong gsum thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bye ru'i sa gzhi dmar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtha' thams cad zangs ri dmar po/ khrag gi na bun 'thul bas khor yug tu bskor ba'i dbus su bhrūṃ las bse dmar po'i pho brang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ mchong gi ba gam la keng rus kyi sham bus brgyan pa'i bya 'dab rnams kyi 'og tu bar snang la 'phyang ba'i mi mgo dang rgyu ma rlon pa'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed/ ro skra'i rnga g.yab/ thod pa'i zla phyed/ bandha'i cha lang rnams kyis brgyan pa/ dbus keng rus kyis phur bur phub pa'i rtse mor tsitta dmar po'i tog dang / zur bzhir mi ro'i rgyal mtshan gtsug pa/ sgo bzhir bye ru dmar po'i them skas dang / g.yu dang ra gan gyi ru bzhi la zangs dmar gyi sgo glegs can/ de'i nang gi dbus su thod skam gyi rwa ba zlum po sgo gcig pa/ khrag dron mos byugs pa'i thog la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / rgyu rlon gyi lda lde/ rus chen gyi phreng ba'i za ra tshags 'phyang ba/ de'i steng ngos nam mkha' la byang sprin ser po/ 'brug sgra sgrog cing / glog phreng 'khyug pa las khrag gi ser char drag po 'bab pa bar snang la gser khra dang /

lcags khra mang po 'phur lding gi gshog sgra sgrog cing dgra bgegs kyi klad pa 'bigs pa/ gtum chen dur bya nag po nam mkha'i dbyings nas gshog skor byed pa/ 'ug pa gser mig dang / srin bya thal mdog la sogs pa'i phung byed ltas ngan gyi bya mang po 'thabs shing lding la/ gshog pa brdebs pas 'jigs pa'i gad mo dgod pa/ 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad zangs 'tshub dang / me dpung dmar nag 'khyil zhing 'bar ba'i klong na/ mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram zhing / mi khrag rta khrag mtshor 'khyil ba/ gsur chen gyi dud sprin 'khor zhing 'khrigs pa/ ro langs nag po rgyug cing ha ha'i gad rgyangs dang bcas pas bro 'khrab pa/ 'byung po khus 'debs pa/ keng rus gad mo dgod cing / sha za ngar sgra sgrogs pa/ gzhan yang dred mo mi zan lag pa brdeb pa/ 'phar ba dmar nag rgyug cing rkang pa brdeb pa/ stag gzig dom nag ce spyang mgo dgu pa la sogs pa'i dur khrod kyi gcan gzan mi sdug pa du ma rgyug cing 'dur nas khrag gi dri bsnams zhing baṃ chen mang po 'drad pa/ gnod sbyin dang / rū tra dang / srin po pho mo mang po stong gsum nyul zhing dgra bgegs 'tshol ba/ de ltar 'jigs shing ya nga ba'i dur khrod chen pos yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi thod mkhar gyi dbus su/ rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dmar la dwangs pa/ zhag gi rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du zangs kyi brag ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du padma dang nyi ma/ mi ro rta ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la praṃ las zangs kyi ral gri praṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer rno zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod sbyin sgrol gying bshan pa dmar po/ sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od can/ sha rgyas shing / bongs thung ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

zhal dmar po cher gdangs shing grwa 'phyang ba'i nang nas khrag dron mo lang long khol ba/ ljags 'dril zhing skad sgra dang gad rgyangs chen po sgrogs pa/ mche ba rnon po zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me stag 'phro ba/ dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings shing / zangs rmog me 'od 'phro ba la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod bcings pa gsol ba/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba dang bcas pas zangs gri dmar po nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod pa/ phyag g.yon na mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying dmar po khrag 'dzag pa rtsa lag dang bcas pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na bye ru'i dbyug pa dang / bse'i mdung dmar la dar gyi ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ spyan dang zhal dang shangs nas me 'bar zhing / khro chu zangs zhun lta bur 'phro ba/ ba spu dang sen mo rnams gnam lcags rab tu 'bar ba las grub pa/ dar dmar gyi ral gud dang / zangs khrab sku la gsol ba/ ra dmar gyi slog pa lding thabs su gyon pa/ mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs la sag ti dmar po'i rb+pa 'bog gsol ba/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du padma dang nyi ma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng du/ maṃ las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma srin mo'i gzugs can/ sku mdog sngo nag bse'i gdong pa dmar po khro zhing khrag 'dzag pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dung gi mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas mi ro rlon pa za zhing 'cha' ba/ spyan gsum dgra la khrag mig tu blta ba/ g.yu'i smin ma sngon mo gzings shing 'bar ba/ me'i ral pa dmar po lan bu mthur du 'phyang ba la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa gser gyi rna cha can/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri rnon po dgra la 'phyar zhing /

g.yon pa lcags kyi phur pa bgegs la 'debs pa/ sha rid cing nu ma 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam rlon dang / sbrul rus kyis brgyan pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ dred mo nag mo mi zan la zhon nas stong gsum skad cig nyid la nyul zhing skye 'gro'i srog dbugs sdud pa'o/ /gtso bo'i g.yas su khrag zhag rba klong dkyil du/ traṃ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po khro zhing rngams pa/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas dgra la khus 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon pa/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar ba dan dang bcas pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/ lce spyang la zhon nas mtshan mo rgyu zhing / dam nyams pa'i bla nas 'bod pa'o/ /gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar khrag dmar/ lhor ri rtse mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag kau sha shar lhor i kri mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro tri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha sham mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste/ srog gcod kyi gying chen brgyad po thams cad mdog dmar po/ 'jigs shing mi sdug pa phyag g.yas zangs gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa klad khrag gis gang ba thogs pa gcer bu liṅga gyen la bsgrengs pa/ gshin rje khros pa'i gzugs can/ ral pa kham nag rgyab tu gsig cing / dgra bo'i sha khrag srog dbugs la rngams pa'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol du bshan pa me ru rtse/ srog gcod bdud kyi bu/ las bdud du ru gi srin po mi zan/ gshin rje stag 'thabs/ srin po mi rengs/ sog po sha zan/ mi dmar bshan pa/ tho ba gying bdag dung gi rdo rje/ sgrol gying dbang sdud/ gying chen rta khrid/ rdo rje gying chen/ srog bdag la li/ bshan pa mi zan/ 'jigs byed rdo rje/ shugs sgrol mgyogs byed/ legs nyes btang 'dzin/ bdud po sha zan/ gshin rje stag mgo can/ bshan pa glang mgo can te/ bshan pa nyer gcig po thams cad kyang /

phyag g.yas zangs gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon pa la las rgyu ma lag bsdogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'drad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa ldag pa/ la la sha khrag spar gyis 'debs pa/ la la nang khrol rgyu ma 'dren pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la pags pa dmar bshus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'ding ba/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog dbugs len pa la rings pa mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gos su gyon pa/ thod pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o/ /bse mkhar gyi nang gi khyams la myur mgyogs kyi btsan dmar stong / go cha gyon zhing dar gyi ru mtshon 'phyar ba/ zhags pa dmar po mda' ltar du 'phen zhing btsan rta dmar zhur la zhon nas rgyug cing 'dral ba/ srog gcod kyi bdud nag stong / bdud kyi khram shing thogs pas dam nyams khram la 'debs pa/ sha zan gyi gshin rje stong 'jigs pa'i gad mo dgod cing dung 'bud pa'i 'ur sgras sa gzhi g.yo ba/ mi sdug pa'i gnod sbyin stong rol mo sna tshogs brdung zhing dgra bo bslu khrid byed pa/ srog gcod kyi srin po stong gar 'chams bskor ba byed cing sha khrag dron mo bza' ba/ phyi'i khor yug la nad bdag gi ma mo bye ba kha nas nad kyi rlangs pa 'thul zhing / lag na nad rkyal thogs pas khrag nad dal yams char ltar 'bebs pa/ phung byed kyi the'u rang stong brtse zhing cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pas dung gi cho long 'phen pa/ gzhan yang snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol ba/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la brtson pa/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ gtso 'khor de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ byang shar dbang ldan ma ru rtse'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas/

gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas sprin 'thibs pa ltar byon par bsams la/ dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs sgrog pa'am/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu gsil bas kyang rung ste/ kyai yul gcig mya ngan 'das bdun pha rol na/ /mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsigs/ /mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag du mas mtsho ltar bskyil/ /khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor/ /bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can/ /thod mkhar brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ /chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol/ /'khor tshogs shan pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol/ /zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gis las bcol bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wa ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan pa/ /mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las byed bshan pa gtum po sde lnga dang / /ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /rakmo pra ṇa atma sa pa ri wā ra a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ zhes brjod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma tha/

sa ma ya rakṣantu/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gshin rje gshed/ ma hā de wa/ e ka dza ṭī/ a tsarya/ nyi 'od grags pa/ paṇḍi ta zla ba nag po/ paṇḍi ta ga ya dhā ra/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar la sogs pa/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la sdang zhing tho 'tshams pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad da lta nyid du thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog pa dang / ji ltar bcol ba'i las thams cad myur ba nyid du bsgrub par mdzod cig ces brjod cing thal mo brdab bo/ /rgyas par na ra dmar khrag chang sogs tshigs bcad sngon du 'gro ba'am/ bsdu na/ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra a/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐/ ru pa/ shapta/ ghandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ ma hā pañtsa/ a mṛ ta/ ma hā rakta pu tsi ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa so so'i phyag rgya bca' zhing khrag chang 'thor ro/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs nas gsol bar bsam/ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bighnān sha trūṃ a mu ka mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul zhing / rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra a nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ zhes pas khrag chang gtor la phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai dmar chen gyi gtor ma ro brgya dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ gshin rje gshed kyi bka' bstod/ ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan/ rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru rtse'i gnas srung /

li yul chos kyi srung ma/ 'dod khams ma mo'i mnga' bdag btsan dmar stong gi dmag dpon/ gshin rje rnams kyi gtso bo/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi yang rje/ bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon/ dgra dang bgegs kyi bshan pa/ dam tshig nyams pa'i rjes gcod/ mna' zan yongs kyi dbugs len/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi pho nya/ rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ba/ legs nyes gnyis kyi btang 'dzin/ bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan 'byed/ dge sdig gnyis kyi spang len/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ yum sring mo khrag gi ral ba can/ sras gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ las mkhan srog bdag bshan pa dmar po/ sgrol byed kyi gying brgyad/ ro bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la 'bul ba yin pas bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyongs/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma mdzod/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ dus da nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad lus dang sems kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa dang mi nor zas gsum dbang du 'du zhing / thos bsam sgom pa'i phrin las thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdo ba/ dkon mchog gsum la bskur pa 'debs pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams la sdang zhing bsdigs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi pho rgyud rtsad nas chod/

mo rgyud drungs nas phyung / chung rgyud mngal nas skems/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i brten phur thon/ skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ mdza' ba'i bshes dang phyes/ mkho ba'i yo byad stor/ ltag nas bdud chod/ mdun nas mdangs phrogs/ khong nas snying phyung / rnam shes rten dang phrol/ drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la thams cad thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig a mu ka sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces dmod bcol drag po bya zhing thal mo lan gsum brdab bo/ /yang de bas bskyed chog sogs bsdus pa la dga' na gtor bsngo bsdus pa rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pas chog de nas gong du bshams pa'i dud pa rnams sbyar/ dar dmar sogs 'phyar/ rnga rol rkang gling shugs pa bya zhing / dar dmar srog sngags can g.yab/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos ngag tu rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral gyi gtso mdzad dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyoḥ byang shar dbang ldan mtshams kyi dur khrod na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /phu na brag ri dmar po zangs se zang / /mda' na khrag mtsho dmar po me re re/ /bar na byang dar dmar po cha la la/ steng na sprul pa'i bya dmar lings se ling / /'og na mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram/ /dbus na bse mkhar dmar po lam se lam/ /mtshan nyid kun rdzogs bse mkhar pho brang nas/ /sngon gyi lha chen ma hā de wa dang / /yum chen e ka dza ṭī'i thugs kyi sras/ /ma gcig srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dred mo mi zan chibs/ /zhi ba'i las mtshon dbu skra mchong gi mdog /rgyas pa'i las mtshon stag lpags ser pos brgyan/

/dbang gi las mtshon gdong pa bse ltar dmar/ /drag po'i las mtshon ind+ra nī la'i mdog /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /g.yas na gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse ba/ /dbang gi las mtshon sku mdog dmar la rngams/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i 'phrul gyi rta la chibs/ /rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /rngams brjid 'gying bas srid gsum zil gyi gnon/ /gdug pa tshar gcod mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i tsitta zhal du gsol/ /srung ma'i dbang po beg gdong lcam dral gnyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa dpag med dang / /'khor dang bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /yab yum gyi srog sngags mthar e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra a nas/ shapta pra tītstsha hūm̐ bar gong bzhin thug la gzungs thag btags pa bzung la rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par spros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus mthu blta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar phri li li yod par gyur/ zhes dang / ru mtshon la btags pa'i gzung thag bzung la/ rta mgrin yang gsang sogs bdag bskyed kyi sngags ci rigs pas 'go mnan lcam dral gyi sngags gong bzhin ci 'grub bzlas la gzungs thag bsdus/ de nas gsol kha'i chas rnams nas byang phyogs su tshar gcig bshams rnga rol dbyangs bcas lhor phyogs pas/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las nas/ gus pas 'dud bar gong gtor bsngo bzhin bstod la/ de nas sngar bshams pa'i kha zas dum bu rnams gtor ma la nar mar sbran cing /

hūm̐/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan gnod sbyin che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shugs mthu rtsal ldan/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /beg tse lcam dral 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/ /dges pa'i tshul gyis mchod do 'di bzhes shig /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po nyer dgongs te/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ces brjod la de nas gtor ma la sman rag gi phud bran te/ ho gshin rje gshed kyi bka' bstod/ ma hā de wa'i bka' nyan/ rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru rtse'i gnas srung / li yul chos kyi srung ma/ 'dod khams ma mo'i mnga' bdag btsan dmar stong gi dmag dpon/ gshin rje rnams kyi gtso bo/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi yang rje/ bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon/ dgra dang bgegs kyi bshan pa/ dam tshig nyams pa'i rjes gcod/ mna' zan yongs kyi dbugs len/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi pho nya/ rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ba/ legs nyes gnyis kyi btang 'dzin/ bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan 'byed/ dge sdig gnyis kyi spong len/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can/ sras gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ las mkhan srog bdag bshan pa dmar po/ sgrol byed kyi gying brgyad/ ro bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /'dren no/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/

dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams spel du gsol/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba dbang du bsdus/ bar chad dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs/ rgyags chad kyi ma mdzod/ blo lhag gi pha mdzod/ rgyab kyi slog pa mdzod/ mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud/ brjed na skul/ mgo gang gi yar la stod/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings/ legs pa brgya dang sprod/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ bsam pa rgya mtsho sgrubs/ re ba rgya mtsho skongs/ mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog dgra dpung thams cad choms/ bgegs dpung thams cad shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang stod/ spo la dar phyor/ khrom du dung bus/ grags pa 'jig rten kun tu sgrogs/ dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor cig ces pa'i gsol kha dang / bcol bskul bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / slar yang byang nas te/ de lta bu lan lnga bya zhing / gzhan yang gang 'dod kyi dmod bskul bya'o/ /de nas mnga' gsol dpangs bstod bya ba ni/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas skyes chen dam pa gzhan gyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba'i mnga' gsol la/ yang na/ kyai/ lha chen ral gcig pho nya mchog /beg tse rigs lnga 'khor bcas la/ /drag po'i las kyi mnga' gsol bas/ /gtum rngam sku gsung thugs kyi las/ /tshar gcod 'jigs rung cho 'phrul gyis/ /bstan dgra gzugs can gzugs med kun/ /skad cig nyid la rdul du rlog /dbang gi las la mnga' gsol bas/ /khams gsum snod bcud ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du g.yo 'gul gyis/ /dad cing 'dun pas dbang du sdud/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga' gsol pas/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde ji snyed pa/

/rab tu rgyas shing spel ba yi/ /snyan grags srid zhi'i dpal kun 'bar/ /zhi ba'i las la mnga' gsol bas/ /yang dag bstan dang bstan 'dzin dang / /'gro ba'i bar chad ma lus sel/ /mchog gi las la mnga' gsol bas/ /dpal chen padma he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang myur ba nyid du stsol/ /de ltar grub gnyis mnga' bdag khyed/ /mtho bar gzeng bstod mnga' gsol lo/ /phyi nang gsang rten la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs dang / /srung ma khyed kyi thugs bskyed dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar bzhed dgu 'byung gyur nas/ /nyams chags ma lus dag pa dang / /thugs dam gnyen po bskong gyur nas/ /grub gnyis re smon gang bsams kun/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ /lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas kyang / /byang chub bar du bsrung skyob mdzod/ /khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ /mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum gyi khams khyab par 'phros nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drang par bsams la/ kyai/ gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ /sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /ma hā de wa'i bka' la nyon/ /gshin rje gshed po'i las mdzod cig /gdong mar mo yi sna drongs la/ /nyams pa'i srog rtsa myur du chod/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /bhyoḥ rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan ma/ /e ka dza ṭī'i gsung bstod ma/ /lha min 'bum gyi g.yul zlog ma/ /bse yi skyes bu'i sna 'dren ma/ /sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul thong / /nga yi nor gyi rting la rgyugs/ /srog bdag dmar po rting la rgyugs/ /nga dang 'gras pa'i dgra bo la/

/cho 'phrul sna dgu thongs la shog /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i/ ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ bhyoḥ beg gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /brten pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /g.yag dmar lus las byung ba yi/ /ba dan rnga g.yab gsang ba'i rdzas/ /mkha' la sprin dmar 'thibs 'dra yi/ /thug dmar nam mkha' khengs pa 'di/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thug dmar 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /thug dmar de yi phyogs mtshams na/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin can/ /dar tshon sna lnga'i rgyan dang ldan/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar mdzes pa 'di/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /mdzes rgyan 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /thug dmar de yi snying po na/ /tsan dan dmar po'i srog shing la/ /rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sogs/ /gzungs sngags zab mo'i rten sngags dang / /dri lnga sman lnga 'bru sna lnga/ /snying po la sogs brten pa'i rdzas/ /ma tshang med pas brgyan pa 'di/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /srog shing 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /srog shing de yi rtse mo la/ /gri lcags chen po las grub pa'i/ /mtshon gyi rgyal po me ri can/ /rnam byang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/ /chos sgra sgrog pa'i sil sgra 'byin/ /dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i mtshon cha 'di/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ru mtshon 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bhyoḥ lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /da ni dam tshig bskul ba ni/ /dang po brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas bka'/ /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog

/longs sku khro rgyal rta mchog bka'/ /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas bka'/ /de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog /grub thob 'dar 'phyar chen po sogs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /drin can nam mkha' legs pa'i bka'/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma de rnams kyi/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /ma dang bu yi tshul du skyongs/ gnas gsar rje dang / brag rtsa rje zhes pa lta bu'i tshig bsgyur/ /brtse gdung byams pa'i sems kyis skyongs/ /gdung sems 'bral ba med par skyongs/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bhyoḥ beg gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /da ni phrin las bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /lus ngag yid la gnod pa dang / /'khor dang nor phyugs gnod pa yi/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang / /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga sogs/ /dam nyams log pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar mdzod/ /nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas par mdzod/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /bsam don yid bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ /lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par mdzod/ /spang rtogs yon tan rgyas par༞ /gzhan don phrin las rgyas༞ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas༞ /rgyas pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /tshe dang bsod nams dbang du sdus/

/dpal dang 'byor pa dbang du sdus/ /'khor dang longs spyod dbang du sdus/ /skye 'gro'i sems can dbang du sdus/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos grub dbang du sdus/ /lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo rnams/ /thams cad khyed kyis dbang du sdus/ /thams cad bdag gi dbang du sdus/ /dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang / /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa dang / /sems can yongs la 'tshe ba dang / /mched dang lcam dral 'tshe ba dang / /bdag nyid chen po'i sku la bsdo/ /de bzhin rigs la brnyas pa dang / /lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba dang / /ngag la tsher ma lta bur zug /mig ngan ce re lta ba dang / /sems ngan tu re sems pa yi/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa rnams/ /srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis rengs par mdzod/ /gzir ba tsam gyis bsad par mdzod/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis rjes su bzung / /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni/ /srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu bu bzhin skyongs/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /tshul khrims bslab pa mthar phyin mdzod/ /ting 'dzin bslab pa mthar phyin mdzod/ /shes rab bslab pa mthar phyin mdzod/ /bslab pa gsum po mthar phyin mdzod/ /bcol pa'i phrin las ma byas na/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs bka' las 'das/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam las 'das/ /srung ma khyed kyi dam tshig nyams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi srung ma khyed/ /rgyun du bsten pa'i dgos pa ci/ /de bas dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bdag gis ci bcol las rnams mdzod/ /bdag kyang byang chub snying po'i bar/ /srung ma'i dbang po khyed mchod do/

/gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni/ /beg gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas kyis/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra mdzod/ /bstan pa spel ba'i srung ma mdzod/ /bstan dgra sgrol ba'i gshed ma mdzod/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gang yin pa'i/ /rigs dang rus dang 'khor tshogs rnams/ /phun sum tshogs kun rgyas par mdzod/ /legs nyes blta ba'i me long mdzod/ /nyes pa sgrib la legs pa ston/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i shes ldan mdzod/ /dor bya spongs la blang bya sgrubs/ /bden rdzun byed pa'i dpang po mdzod/ /rdzun po smod la bden pa bstod/ /mang du rab tu brjod pas ci/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam mdzod/ /lam sna 'dren pa'i bla ma mdzod/ /man ngag ston pa'i slob dpon mdzod/ /bar chad srung ba'i chos skyong mdzod/ /lung ston byed pa'i mkha' 'gro mdzod/ /tshe sgrub rnams kyi tshe lha mdzod/ /nor sgrub rnams kyi nor lha mdzod/ /lam du 'gro ba'i srung ma mdzod/ /tshong la 'gro ba'i tshong dpon mdzod/ /byes la 'gro ba'i dgra lha mdzod/ /mgo gang tsam gyi yar bstod mdzod/ /dkyus gang tsam gyi mar la sring / /legs pa'i ngo so ston pa dang / /nyes pa khong du sbed pa sogs/ /bcol pa'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /mchog dang thun mong ma lus pa'i/ /dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol/ /mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas thal mo sbyar/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/

bstan pa dang rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig rdo rje dang bcas me tog 'thor/ dril gsil rol mo sogs bcas tshar gsum/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs me tog 'thor ba bcas byas la/ gsum pa ni/ tshogs yod na de bzhin lhag ma gtong ba spyi bstabs mjug chog rnams bya'o/ /yang 'di nyid kyi mgon khang ngam rang gi sgrub khang steng sogs nas thug khang ngam/ lha btsugs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs de 'dra'i steng thug sngar yod dam gsar btsugs gang yin kyang skabs 'gar thug chog byed tshul rgyas pa ni gong bzhin la 'don cha 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin nam/ yang na bdag mdun sbyor dngos rjes gsum thog kha de nyid du rgyas bsdus ci byed rigawa pas dpyad nas/ dngos gzhi 'di'i gtor bsngo bskang bshags bstod pa sogs ci rigs grub rjes/ thug khang la bdud rtsi gtor la/ amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thug khang 'di nyid bhrūṃ las byung ba'i bse'i pho brang dmar po gru bzhi pa rgyan sta babs dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i phyi nang kun tu yang bsten pa'i dam rdzas/ mthun pa'i dam rdzas/ bskang ba'i dam rdzas la sogs pa dam rdzas rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba rnams/ beg gdong lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra ā warta ya/ ā warta ya hoḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bhyoḥ beg gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /bsten pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /thug khang dmar po gzhal yas khang / /bhrūṃ las bskyed pa'i khang bzang mchog /gru bzhi zangs kyi sgo bzhi ldan/ /byi ru'i ba gam bzhi dang bcas/

/mtshan nyid kun rdzogs khang bzang 'di/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /khang bzang 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /khang bzang 'di yi nang du yang / /thug dmar rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i/ /bsten pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /g.yab dar dmar po la sogs pa'i/ /'bod pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i tsitta sogs/ /gsang ba'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /thug dmar lcags ru'i tsitta sogs/ /dges pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyor sogs/ /gsang ba'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /dam rdzas rgyan ldan gtor ma sogs/ /bskang ba'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dang / /gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ni/ /dngos dang yid las byung gyur pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ /mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med rnams/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam rdzas rnams la bzhugs su gsol/ /bzhugs nas bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /khang bzang de'i steng shod na/ /g.yag dmar lug las byung ba yi/ /zhes pa nas/ dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol bar gong bzhin/ rjes chog bcas bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas ru mtshon de la bstan srung 'go zhing chags pas legs nyes btang 'dzin 'phral du 'byung bas rang gzhan kun nas bag yod par bya ba ni gnad kyi man ngag go /zhes pa 'di yang 'dar ban rig 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'di'i thug gsos chen mo'i yi ge'i legs cha rnams bsdus nas sa skya pa kun blos rang gzhan la phan phyir bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 18 kun dga' blo gros/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral gyi thug chog gtum drag 'od 'bar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
